title: Hoti language
description: Austronesian language spoken in Maluku, Indonesia
extract: Hoti is an extinct Austronesian language of Seram, Indonesia, once spoken by the Hoti People. It was spoken by 10 elderly people in 1987, but was likely extinct by 2007. It is said to have been replaced by Geser.
